definitions.explanation: A writing instrument with a graphite core encased in wood. A basic school and office supply.

examples.japanese: {鉛筆|えんぴつ}で{書|か}いてください。
{鉛筆|えんぴつ}を{貸|か}してください。
この{鉛筆|えんぴつ}は{短|みじか}いです。

notes:
{鉛筆|えんぴつ} is a writing instrument with a graphite core, part of basic stationery vocabulary.

COUNTER:
{本|ほん} is used: {一|いっ}{本|ぽん}, {二|に}{本|ほん}, {三|さん}{本|ぼん}, etc.

COMMON EXPRESSIONS:
- {鉛筆|えんぴつ}を{削|けず}る: to sharpen a pencil
- {鉛筆|えんぴつ}で{書|か}く: to write with a pencil
- {鉛筆|えんぴつ}の{芯|しん}: pencil lead

RELATED WORDS:
- シャープペンシル (シャーペン): mechanical pencil
- {色|いろ}{鉛筆|えんぴつ}: colored pencil
- ボールペン: ballpoint pen
- {消|け}しゴム: eraser
